parameters.query: =SELECT hero_image, hero_image_my, hero_fit, hero_pos, svc_tradein_icon, svc_testride_icon, benefits, category_overrides, faq, faq_my FROM site_config WHERE brand = '{{ $json.brand }}' LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode:
const row = $input.first()?.json || {};
return [{ json: { heroImage: row.hero_image || '', heroImage_my: row.hero_image_my || '', heroFit: row.hero_fit || 'cover', heroPos: row.hero_pos || 'center center', svcTradeinIcon: row.svc_tradein_icon || '', svcTestrideIcon: row.svc_testride_icon || '', benefits: row.benefits || [], categoryOverrides: row.category_overrides || {}, faq: row.faq || [], faq_my: row.faq_my || [] } }];
